info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Live Zoho CRM records and server-side metrics for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Semantic concepts such as converted, conversion rate, revenue, pipeline, and top owner are business operations, not CRM field names.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this single tool for every CRM question. Send the user's natural-language question unchanged in the question property. The backend owns intent detection, module selection, Zoho field mapping, filters, owner resolution, date ranges, pagination, aggregation, conversion logic, and answer generation. Do not construct module names, field names, owner IDs, filters, COQL, date criteria, or conversion logic in Copilot Studio. Do not call an alternate structured CRM operation. Never emit a Leads field named Converted; Converted is not a CRM API field. Conversion questions must remain natural language and be handled by the backend.
info.x-copilot-studio-input-policy: The question property is required and must contain the user's complete natural-language CRM request. Ask a clarifying question in conversation when the user's request is ambiguous; do not guess CRM fields or criteria.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, grouped, and lead-conversion questions and executes the required filtered Zoho CRM query or queries.

400.description: Invalid question, field, date, owner, or aggregate request.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or query failure.

AssistantRequest.description: Natural-language CRM question. Send the complete user request in question.

fields.description: Fields for record requests. Metric requests may omit fields. If omitted or empty for a record request, the backend will use a safe default field set for the selected module. For Leads, NEVER use 'Converted'; it is not a CRM API field. Use the analysis operation for conversion questions, or only verified fields Converted__s, Converted_Date_Time, Converted_Account, Converted_Contact, and Converted_Deal.

request_type.description: Execution mode. Records use the existing paginated contract; count, aggregate, and analysis use server-side CRM queries.

group_by.description: Valid Zoho field used to group aggregate rows.

filters.description: Optional structured conditions. Multiple filters are combined as AND conditions. Semantic concepts such as converted, revenue, pipeline, and conversion rate must be translated into operations, never invented field names.

sort_field.description: Zoho CRM API field used to sort the returned records.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records to return. The first request for a new question should normally use 20.

offset.description: Number of CRM records to skip for pagination. A new CRM question must start at 0; a continuation may use the next offset after the previous limit.

field.description: Zoho CRM API field on which the filter is applied.

value.description: Filter value. Numeric comparison values such as 50000 may be sent as strings by Copilot Studio and are interpreted by the backend for numeric comparisons. Use a scalar string for equals, contains, and comparisons; use the backend-supported scalar array for in and exactly two scalar values for between. Omit value for is_null and is_not_null.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

module.description: The Zoho CRM module from which the records were retrieved.

count.description: Number of CRM records returned in the current response.

data.description: The actual CRM records returned by Zoho CRM. Use this data to answer the user's request.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records returned in this response.

offset.description: Number of CRM records skipped before this response.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional CRM records are available beyond the current response.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

error.description: Structured error information returned by the backend.

details.description: Additional structured error details, when available.
